# Environment Dependency Risk

The AtlassianJiraGateway constructor requires environment variables (JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN) to be set. If any are missing, it raises a JiraError, causing failures in the Jira collection process.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/jira.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.jira.AtlassianJiraGateway.__init__`
